name: Simon Brown
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: For over seventeen years, Simon has been counselling people experiencing a variety of life and mental health challenges in his clinical practice. Every client is regarded by him as unique and is listened to with the greatest care. Simon believes that people are the experts in their own lives but, when they find themselves battered and bruised by life, sometimes it can be hard to see the solutions.

name: Tamara How
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: At The Counselling Avenue, we focus on client wellness believing that this is not the absence of unhappiness or sadness but the presence of gratitude, happiness and hope. We work in a holistic and integrative manner to find the inner strengths that our clients bring to therapy. Tamara is guided by her client’s needs and uses a range of therapeutic interventions such as person-centred, narrative, gestalt, strength-based and trauma-informed therapies.

name: Lisa Menzel
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Well Within Counselling offers generalist counselling and support to children, young people and adults, in the areas of anxiety, grief, depression, trauma, emotional health and wellbeing, adolescent behaviour, parenting strategies, problem solving and goal setting. Online counselling & after-hours sessions available. Please visit my website & Facebook page for further information.

name: Lucy Pierce
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Trauma recovery.

name: Sonia Donnellan
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I am a certified practicing Gestalt counsellor and psychotherapist, and a professionally registered Art Therapist. My therapeutic approach has been enriched by a four year Gestalt Therapy course at Gestalt Therapy Australia and I have training in EMDR and Schema Therapy. I have worked with a wide range of clients experiencing anxiety and depression, grief and loss, stress and isolation, the impact of complex trauma and PTSD on their life, perinatal mental health and women’s mental health.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Mary Ellen Jordan
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I am a general adult counsellor and psychotherapist. I also offer life coaching for autistic people and ADHDers, including coaching to support people with autistic burnout.
